scope: Selected generator, sampler, matrix-kernel, QTL and QL tests. Clean-clone checks do not mount external edgeR reference data. No native ARM64 performance measurement is claimed.

source_identity.only_changes_after_container_checkout: Release runner and benchmark timing guards/reference-path configuration.

host_note: These correctness checks ran on CPUs 0-7 under nice 10 before the final-policy timing restart. Their source-identity evidence and pass/fail results remain valid. Elapsed times are test diagnostics; they do not belong to the final benchmark collection or its CPU-policy audit.
_timing_scope: Retained correctness checks; elapsed diagnostics are not benchmark measurements.

memory.evidence: Final host setting supplied by the user; BIOS/microcode and RAPL limits independently read at preflight.

_benchmark_host_configuration.reproducibility: Every timed run is pinned to identical efficiency cores, one thread per core, under the shared lock after a quiet-host check. Absolute seconds from other host settings are not directly comparable; matched tool speed-up ratios are the comparison of interest.
